ablations.description: Calibrated reliability evidence with stable reference and no learned intervention-utility selector.
ablations.name: M4qcesi-c

ablations.description: Frozen/raw reliability evidence feeding the intervention-utility selector without calibration transform.
ablations.name: M4qcesi-u

ablations.description: Calibrated evidence plus intervention-utility selector with bounded selective action.
ablations.name: M4qcesi

evaluation_protocol.quality_conditions: same frozen 19-condition validation matrix used in v0.30

criteria: graded mean Macro-F1 delta vs M4qcs-w >= +0.005 across 36 paired seed-condition comparisons
V31_H1.name: graded_corruption_robustness

criteria: net harmful lower than each ablation
V31_H3.name: combined_mechanism_superiority

criteria: graded active rate - clean active rate >= 0.10
catastrophic active rate >= graded active rate
mismatch active rate - matched active rate >= 0.10
intervention utility mean higher in mismatched than matched conditions
intervention utility severity response non-decreasing for text Gaussian, vision Gaussian, text attenuation, and vision attenuation with tolerance 0.02
V31_H4.name: utility_selectivity

criteria: conditions with larger clean-to-corruption degradation must not systematically receive lower mean intervention utility than low-degradation conditions
high-utility conditions must not show a lower mean performance delta vs M4qcs-w than low-utility conditions
criterion bins and any reporting thresholds must be prospectively frozen before formal evaluation
V31_H5.name: evidence_utility_alignment
V31_H5.note: Exact binning/reporting thresholds must be frozen in Step2 or later operationalization before any formal evaluation; until then V31_H5 remains structurally defined but NOT_COMPUTED.

calibrated_evidence.goal: Map raw quality/compatibility/transition-risk evidence into a calibrated reliability-risk representation before intervention selection.
calibrated_evidence.requirement: Calibration mechanism and constants must be frozen in Step2 before formal training.

do_no_harm_default.intervention_trigger: requires prospective evidence of likely utility
do_no_harm_default.requirement: low utility must converge toward no intervention

intervention_utility_selector.goal: Estimate whether intervention is likely to be useful, not merely whether corruption risk is high.
intervention_utility_selector.inputs: Training-split-available evidence only; no validation/test labels.
intervention_utility_selector.requirement: Utility score must modulate bounded intervention magnitude.
